news.description: In 2024, Bronny James joined his father LeBron on the Los Angeles Lakers. Take a closer look at the highest-scoring father-son duos in NBA history.

news.headline: Curry's ankle-breaker on Luka highlights Warriors' stunning 25-point comeback
news.linkText: Curry's ankle-breaker on Luka highlights Warriors' stunning 25-point comeback
news.description: Behind a theatrical 31 points from Stephen Curry, the Warriors roared back for a 112-95 win over the Lakers.

images.name: Stephen Curry [600x400]
images.caption: Stephen Curry brought the crowd to its feet when he dropped Luka Doncic to the floor before hitting a 3 for the Warriors, who turned a 25-point deficit into a 17-point win.

events.name: LA Clippers at Golden State Warriors

rotowire.headline: Curry (rest) won't play Sunday against the Clippers, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
rotowire.story: Sunday's game will be the first of a back-to-back set, so Curry will receive a maintenance day, but he should return for Monday's meeting with the Suns. De'Anthony Melton could draw the start sans Curry, and Brandin Podziemski will be more involved in the offense.

awards.name: Twyman-Stokes Teammate of the Year Award

fantasy.projection: Curry played only 43 games last season, and reportedly there are concerns about the long-term health of his knee going into this season. Entering his 18th season at age 38, durability and availability are legitimate concerns for Curry. He is still an elite producer when he's on the court, but it is risky to draft him early in fantasy leagues.
